notable_absence.finding: Roughly 30 rows of Table 1 - every logging.console/error/warn/info/debug/trace/stats.rotation.* and .collation_buffer_size sub-property - have a completely EMPTY Description cell in the source markdown itself (verified against the raw file, not an extraction gap). This is a genuine authoring gap in the reference table, not something this extraction chose to skip; only the log_level and log_keys rows in that family carry any description at all.

cross_component_finding: sgw:max-file-descriptors-setting appears on this page only as a bare table row with no default value stated ('Max number of open file descriptors (RLIMIT_NOFILE)', Default column blank); the OS-level-tuning.md page in this same batch is where the actual default (5000) and the OS/container ceiling that silently caps it are documented. Neither page cross-links to the other despite covering the same setting from two different angles (declare-it-here vs. tune-the-ceiling-there).
cross_product_finding: The five bootstrap.* TLS flags on this page (bootstrap.use_tls_server, bootstrap.server_tls_skip_verify, bootstrap.ca_cert_path, bootstrap.x509_cert_path, bootstrap.x509_key_path) are the identical settings an earlier round's security/secure-sgw-access.json extraction record described in prose from the security/ tree - confirmed here as extraction-layer reuse rather than re-minted, since the same setting recurring in a second, differently-framed page (reference table vs. security walkthrough) is exactly the kind of signal that should raise a term's recurrence count toward promotion.
